note: Renaming the config — its identifier is immutable, because blobs name it.
A state change — retiring is vtc/storage/configs/retire.
A roleArn that is not an IAM role ARN — it is passed to STS and placed in a session policy's partition, so only a role ARN is accepted.
A roleArn with characters outside the IAM role-name set (a quote, a space) — it must never be able to carry anything but a name.
roleArn belongs only to ambient authentication; a vta-account auth naming one is malformed.
A sealed auth carrying a credential — sealed credentials are set only with vtc/storage/credentials/set, sealed end to end.
